title: Scrub Life Helper
description: A server-side mod that adds support for a life system based off of Grian's Last Life series.
body:
# 🌱 Scrub Life Helper

> **Server-side only** mod inspired by *Grian’s Last Life series*.  
> Brings randomized lives, the Boogeyman system, and color-coded player names to your server.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎲 **Randomized Lives System**  
  Players start with **2–6 lives**, rolled randomly at the beginning of the game.

- 👹 **Boogeyman Support**  
  - Randomly selects a Boogeyman each session.  
  - If the Boogeyman fails to kill someone before the session ends, they are reduced to **1 life**.

- 🎨 **Chat & Tab Coloring** (based on lives left)

1 Life → 🔴 Red

2 Lives → 🟡 Yellow

3 Lives → 🟢 Light Green

4+ → 🌳 Dark Green

- ❤️ **Life Sharing**  
/givelife <name> → Gives one of your lives to another player

yaml
Copy code

---

## 📜 Commands

/randomizelives → Starts the randomized lives loop

/boogeyman → Runs the Boogeyman selector

/givelife <name> → Give another player one of your lives

/endsession → Ends the current session; failed Boogeyman gets 1 life

---

## 🔧 Requirements

Server-side only

No client installation needed

Works on multiplayer servers

---

⚔️ Perfect for running your own **Last Life–style survival challenge** with friends!
